rally support: The mayor traveled from town to town to rally support for the new plan to build a public library.
市長走訪各個城鎮，為興建公共圖書館的新計畫集結支持。
the market rallied: After falling for three days in a row, the market rallied a little on Friday and recovered part of its losses.
連跌三天之後，股市在星期五小幅反彈，收復了部分跌幅。
rally around a leader: When the country faced a serious crisis, people chose to rally around a leader they could trust.
當國家面臨嚴重危機時，人們選擇團結在一位值得信任的領袖周圍。
rally the troops: Before the final game, the coach gave a passionate speech in the locker room to rally the troops.
決賽前，教練在更衣室發表了一場熱情的演說來鼓舞士氣。
rally from illness: Grandma was weak for weeks, but she began to rally from illness after the doctor changed her medicine.
奶奶虛弱了好幾週，但在醫生換藥之後，她開始病後恢復了。
range from A to B: Ticket prices for the concert range from 500 to 3,000 dollars, depending on where you sit.
這場演唱會的票價從五百元到三千元不等，視座位而定。
range over many topics: The professor's lecture ranged over many topics, from ancient history to modern technology.
教授的演講涉及許多主題，從古代歷史到現代科技都有。
range in age: The volunteers range in age from sixteen to seventy, but they all share a love of helping others.
這些志工年齡介於十六歲到七十歲之間，但他們都熱愛幫助他人。
range widely: Her interests range widely, so she enjoys reading books about science, art, cooking, and travel.
她的興趣範圍廣泛，所以她喜歡閱讀科學、藝術、烹飪和旅遊方面的書。
rank first: Our school choir ranked first in the national contest, so the principal praised them at the morning meeting.
我們學校的合唱團在全國比賽中排名第一，所以校長在朝會上表揚了他們。
rank among the best: This small noodle shop ranks among the best in the city, and there is always a long line outside.
這家小麵店名列全市最佳之一，店外總是大排長龍。
rank by size: The teacher asked us to rank by size all eight planets, starting with Jupiter and ending with Mercury.
老師要我們把八大行星按大小排序，從木星開始，以水星結束。
rank high: Taiwan ranks high on lists of safe places to travel, so many tourists feel comfortable walking alone at night.
台灣在安全旅遊地點的排行中名列前茅，所以許多遊客晚上獨自散步也很安心。
rank and file: The company leaders agreed to the plan, but the rank and file were worried about losing their jobs.
公司高層同意了這項計畫，但基層成員擔心會丟掉工作。
rate highly: Many customers rate this phone highly because its battery can last for two full days.
許多顧客對這支手機評價很高，因為它的電池可以撐整整兩天。
rate as one of the best: Critics rate the movie as one of the best of the year, praising both its story and its music.
影評人將這部電影評為年度最佳之一，稱讚它的故事和配樂。
rate a mention: His small role in the project didn't even rate a mention in the final report, which made him a little upset.
他在這個專案中的小角色在最終報告裡甚至不值得一提，這讓他有點難過。
rate one's chances: Before the election, the reporter asked her how she would rate her chances of winning against the popular mayor.
選舉前，記者問她會如何評估自己對上那位受歡迎市長的勝算。
first-rate: The hotel offers first-rate service, so guests always leave happy and promise to come back.
這家飯店提供一流的服務，所以房客總是開心離開，並承諾會再回來。
rattle off the names: The little boy can rattle off the names of all the dinosaurs in his book without stopping to think.
那個小男孩能不假思索地快速說出書中所有恐龍的名字。
rattle the opponent: The player shouted loudly after every point, trying to rattle the opponent and make her lose focus.
那名選手每得一分就大聲吼叫，想使對手慌亂、失去專注。
be rattled by the news: Mom was rattled by the news of the earthquake and quickly called every family member to make sure they were safe.
媽媽被地震的消息嚇到，趕緊打電話給每位家人確認他們平安。
rattle on: My uncle tends to rattle on about his fishing trips for hours, even when nobody is really listening.
我叔叔常常對他的釣魚之旅喋喋不休好幾個小時，即使根本沒人在聽。
rattle the cage: If you complain to the manager about this again, you might rattle the cage and get yourself into trouble.
如果你再為這件事向經理抱怨，你可能會惹惱他，給自己找麻煩。
reach an agreement: The talks felt like a long journey, but at midnight the two sides finally reached an agreement on sharing the costs.
這場談判就像一趟漫長的旅程，但在午夜時雙方終於就分攤費用達成協議。
reach a decision: The judges needed two hours to reach a decision about which team deserved the gold medal.
評審花了兩個小時才做出決定，選出哪一隊該得金牌。
reach a conclusion: After studying the evidence for weeks, the scientists reached a conclusion that surprised everyone.
研究證據好幾週之後，科學家得出了一個令所有人驚訝的結論。
reach one's goal: She practiced the piano every day for a year to reach her goal of playing in the school concert.
她一整年每天練琴，以達成在學校音樂會演奏的目標。
reach a wider audience: The band started posting videos online to reach a wider audience beyond their small hometown.
這個樂團開始在網路上發布影片，以觸及家鄉小鎮以外更多的觀眾。
within reach: Keep your phone within reach during the trip in case your parents need to call you.
旅行時把手機放在觸手可及的地方，以防你爸媽需要打電話給你。
reach out to: The school counselor encouraged us to reach out to her whenever we feel stressed or lonely.
學校輔導老師鼓勵我們，只要感到壓力大或孤單，就向她求助，她會向我們伸出援手。
